pairs.01-02:
Create actual hand-drawn in-between sprite poses for a frame-by-frame animation. Input image 1 is the START pose, input image 2 is the END pose of the SAME approved character Aurum. Preserve the exact character, adult lion face, mane, body proportions, crossed standing legs, shoes, cream tuxedo, black lapels/shirt/trousers, gold jewelry, one black-and-gold chip in his RIGHT hand at hip on viewer LEFT, gold watch on his LEFT wrist on viewer RIGHT. Same premium stylized 3D render, consistent warm lighting and materials. Generate exactly FOUR distinct FULL-BODY intermediate drawings, 2 columns x 2 rows, reading top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, on true transparent alpha. Use a portrait 3:4 sheet. Each cell has generous transparent space on all sides, feet at identical height relative to its cell, body scale constant, no limbs or tails cross cell boundaries. FULL body including mane, shoes, tail and hands. No background, ground, text, numbers, dividers, halos, props or particle effects. Do not repeat either endpoint: draw 20%, 40%, 60% and 80% progression between them. The crossed legs and feet stay precisely stationary. Only the torso, shoulders, neck, face and LEFT arm articulate; mane and chain react subtly. No translation/zoom of the whole character.
ACTION: The arms and crossed legs remain motionless in the low resting position. Animate only his noticing the viewer: head rotates from looking slightly to viewer right toward eye contact, gaze tracks first, eyebrows lift a little, closed friendly smile softens. Draw small evenly spaced steps at 20%, 40%, 60%, 80% of head/gaze rotation. This is a restrained anticipation, no raised hand, no bow, no big smile. Neck and mane turn with the head; same exact character proportions in every frame.
